riskAssessment.reason: The Work Item changes structural evidence labels and adds an optional serialized dimension. False positives can overstate enterprise change; false negatives can hide useful evidence; legacy snapshots and localized reports must remain compatible.
riskAssessment.reviewNote: The 2026-08-25 dry-run produced five validated Meta engineering claims, including production-system and operating-metric signals that were rendered as organization change. The user approved a dimensioned evidence contract and complete Claim boundary.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly approved the dimensioned structural-evidence design; scope, acceptance, scenarios, and local verification are deterministic and no unknowns remain open.

preReviewWarnings: Do not label production-system or operating-metric evidence as organization change.
Require complete company, claim, date, production-area, source, and passage provenance before structural promotion.
Keep structural dimensions visible in reporting but outside Stage and Ranking computation.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Validated evidence can be classified as Organization, Workflow, ProductionSystem, or OperatingMetric without changing the existing ValidatedFact versus StructuralEvidence boundary.

A production-system claim such as GPU utilization or deployment remains StructuralEvidence but is reported as ProductionSystem or OperatingMetric, never Organization unless an organization signal is present.

A dated authoritative claim without a complete company, change, effective-date, production-area, source-title, source-URI, and passage boundary remains a regular fact or pending lead and cannot become StructuralEvidence.
NormalizedFact persists the optional structural dimension with backward-compatible defaults; legacy snapshots deserialize unchanged.
Chinese, Japanese, and English reports render the dimension-specific labels while legacy structural-change and confirmed-information inputs remain readable.
Generic research or architecture prose without an explicit structural signal remains a regular validated fact or pending lead.
The existing Stage, Ranking, Counter Evidence, Telegram, archive, and workflow behavior is unchanged.
TDD fixtures cover all four dimensions, a generic negative, incomplete claim data, legacy serialization, and localized report rendering.
Weekly Radar operations documentation explains the dimension taxonomy and Claim completeness boundary.
All Contract governance, focused tests, project quality, and hosted CI checks pass before Finish.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.
Keep evidence classification deterministic, provider-neutral, bounded, and rule-only.
Prefer false negatives to promoting technical prose as structural enterprise change.
Preserve legacy snapshot deserialization by defaulting new fields to zero or None.
Do not change judgment, Ranking, Telegram, archive, or workflow behavior outside the structural evidence dimension boundary.

intent.problem: The post-merge dry-run produced five validated Meta engineering claims, but two production-system or operating-metric claims were rendered as organization change. The existing structural evidence class has no explicit dimension, so readers cannot distinguish organization, workflow, production-system, and operating-metric change. The Claim gate also needs an explicit completeness contract so a partially populated record cannot be promoted by a lexical signal alone.
constraints: Preserve the existing SourceObservation to EvidenceCandidate to ValidatedEvidence pipeline and the current evidence kind prefixes.
Use deterministic lexical rules and bounded fields only; do not add an LLM, probabilistic model, provider, dependency, or broader crawl.
Keep legacy NormalizedFact and RuntimeReportInput JSON deserializable with optional dimension defaults.
Do not change Stage, Ranking, Counter Evidence, Telegram, archive, data-branch, or workflow behavior.
intent.rationale: An explicit optional dimension is the smallest compatible change that makes structural evidence semantically honest. It fixes the reader-facing mislabel without discarding validated technical evidence or expanding the judgment layer.
